name: Generic CM108/CM119 USB interface
notes: Any URI-style USB sound card interface: PTT on the chip's GPIO3, carrier detect on its VOL_DN input, pulled low on carrier. Set the levels yourself on the Audio page.

name: DMK URI
notes: PTT on GPIO3, carrier detect on VOL_DN (active low).

name: USB-RIM Lite
notes: PTT on GPIO3, carrier detect on VOL_DN (active low).

name: AIOC (All-In-One-Cable)
notes: PTT through the AIOC's CM108-style interface (firmware 1.2 or newer). Carrier detect is the AIOC's virtual COS, which recent firmware sends on VOL_DN by default; if the repeater never opens, switch carrier detect to audio level (VOX) on the Audio page.

name: SVXLink Card
notes: A Pi HAT with two USB sound cards. Port 1 is the repeater; port 2 can run a link radio. Carrier detect and PTT are Pi header pins.

name: SVXLink Basic Board
notes: A Pi board with two USB sound cards. Port 1 is the repeater; port 2 can run a link radio. Carrier detect (active high) and PTT are Pi header pins.

name: ICS Pi Repeater 1X
unsupported: Its PTT is on an I/O expander, not a Pi header pin, and each port is one channel of a stereo codec. moreopenrepeater can't drive either yet.

name: ICS Pi Repeater 2X
unsupported: Its PTT is on an I/O expander, not a Pi header pin, and each port is one channel of a stereo codec. moreopenrepeater can't drive either yet.
